summary: Phase 3 backend-only testing complete. 13/13 pytest cases PASSED against the public preview URL. Verified: (a) auto-generated FB-NNNNNN vehicle reference numbers on POST /api/submissions, (b) monotonically increasing sequence (counters collection with _id='submission_ref'), (c) `reference` present in /submissions/my, /admin/submissions and /submissions/{id}, (d) DELETE /api/admin/submissions/{id} - admin 200 with {status:'deleted'}, dealer 403, invalid id 404 (and post-delete GET returns 404), (e) POST /api/submissions/{id}/market-analysis - owner dealer 200, admin 200, non-owner dealer 403, missing id 404, model='gpt-5.2', analysis contains either structured keys or `raw` fallback, and (f) market_analysis persisted and visible via GET /submissions/{id}. GPT-5.2 responses came back as structured JSON within ~5s under the Emergent LLM key.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 585 lines - still under 700-line threshold but modularise (routers for auth/vehicles/submissions/admin/ai) before the next feature phase.
Deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') still used (should migrate to FastAPI lifespan) - flagged in iteration_1 and still present at lines 483/582.
Pydantic v1-style .dict() calls remain at server.py lines 186-187, 198-199; prefer .model_dump() for Pydantic v2.

market-analysis endpoint uses a per-submission session_id ('market-<sub_id>') meaning repeated calls on the same submission will share LLM context; consider randomising session_id per call or clearing to keep each analysis stateless.
market-analysis has no rate-limit / debounce - a dealer can spam the endpoint and burn LLM budget (owner check exists but no cooldown or last-generated guard).

next_reference_number() uses find_one_and_update with upsert - correct pattern; but the counters _id 'submission_ref' has no index/uniqueness guarantee separate from the _id primary key (fine, just note).
admin_delete_submission does not cascade any related artefacts (e.g., photos would already be embedded so ok, but any future push-notification history / audit trail would be orphaned).
photos field (5x base64 images) is still embedded in submission docs (BSON 16MB risk) - same call-out as iteration_1.
seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral dealers per run (phase3_owner_* and phase3_other_*, TEST_ prefixed company names). Multiple submissions created; one is deleted via the admin endpoint. Remaining ephemeral submissions accumulate in DB per run (dealer_id filters keep them isolated).
